text:
Alex P: Quick question — traveling to the Redwood Summit next week. 3 days + 1 offsite dinner. Is everyone still team backpack or wheelie suitcase for this kind of trip? Trying to avoid checked bag if possible.
Maya R: Backpack for me. Easier on public transit and you can shove a jacket + laptop in. No checked bag drama. :+1:
Ryan C: Roller if you care about shoes/dress clothes. My shirts survive better in a small roller than a backpack. Also easier at airports with long walks.
Ciara: Pro tip — put dress shoes in a shoe bag and between layers so they don’t squish shirts. Also check coat check at venue for the dinner.
Samir: If you do backpack, get a laptop compartment that zips off or a TSA-friendly sleeve. Worst is digging for the laptop in a crowded checkpoint.
Alex P: Anyone bring both? thinking of a small roller + daypack. Feels like overkill but less stressed.
Maya R: That's what I did for a biz trip last month. Roller with a slim blazer + shoes, daypack for laptop + chargers. Very chill.
Ryan C: Also remember battery bank rules — if it’s >100Wh airlines want to know. I keep a 20k mAh that’s fine.
Ciara: Also liquids — travel bottles in a clear quart bag. TSA 100ml limit still enforced.
Samir: For short trips I use packing cubes, saves so much space.
luggage-bot: Packing checklist suggestion generated:

```
- 1 blazer / 2 shirts (roll)
- 1 pair dress shoes (shoe bag)
- 1 pair casual shoes
- socks / underwear in packing cube
- laptop + charger in daypack
- 1 battery bank (<100Wh)
- travel toiletries (<=100ml) in clear bag
- phone charger / adapters
- small stain pen + wrinkle spray
```

Alex P: Nice — anyone close to the venue willing to offer a quick fold/steam for blazers? I'm trying not to buy a travel steamer. :sweat_smile:
Maya R: I have a handheld one, happy to help before the dinner. DM me. :sparkles:
Ryan C: Vote time: :thumbsup: backpack, :thumbsdown: roller — shout with emoji in thread so Alex can see real-time.
Samir: :thumbsup: (backpack)
Ciara: :thumbsdown: (roller)
Alex P: Thanks everyone — leaning roller+daypack now. Appreciate the steam offer @Maya R :heart:
